title: DeepSeek-V3
body: DeepSeek-V3 is a large Mixture-of-Experts language model with 671B total parameters, activating only 37B per token. Its efficient MoE routing and multi-head latent attention made frontier-level quality feasible at a fraction of the training cost of dense models of comparable scale.

title: Mixture of Experts
body: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) splits a network into expert sub-networks with a learned router. Only a few experts fire per token, giving a huge parameter count at low inference cost. Trade-offs include routing instability and high memory for parameters.

title: RLHF
body: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback aligns models to human preferences: a reward model is trained on pairwise human judgments, then the policy is fine-tuned against it. Variants like DPO and RLAIF reduce or replace the reward model.

title: Quantization
body: Quantization lowers numerical precision (e.g. FP16→INT8/INT4) to shrink model size and speed inference. Post-training quantization can lose accuracy; quantization-aware training keeps quality high for 4-bit and lower.

title: Attention mechanisms
body: Attention lets a model weigh all tokens of a sequence against each other. Multi-head attention runs several attention heads in parallel; multi-head latent attention (MLA) compresses the KV cache, cutting memory at long contexts.

title: Knowledge distillation
body: Distillation transfers knowledge from a large teacher model into a smaller student by training on the teacher's soft outputs. It can compress a model several-fold while retaining most task quality.

title: Vector databases
body: Vector databases index embeddings for similarity search, powering retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). ANN indexes like HNSW trade a little recall for massive speedups at scale.

title: Gated shell
body: HAZOOM OS gates the shell with an allowlist: git inspection, process and system info commands run; destructive or network-mutating commands are denied with a reason code. GitOps commands run automatically after every signed push.

title: GitHub webhooks
body: The GitHub bridge validates webhook payloads with HMAC-SHA256 using a shared secret, then broadcasts events over WebSockets to the OS desktop and runs ops/commands.json GitOps commands. Polling can also be enabled with a GITHUB_TOKEN.

title: Consciousness engine
body: HAZOOM OS ships a Pascal-engine consciousness core: attention, memory, reasoning, and introspective states exposed via /api/consciousness, with Q-learning for adaptive behavior.

title: Charmed Kubernetes
body: HAZOOM OS runs on a Charmed Kubernetes cluster managed by Juju. The dev farm registers its microservices as Services and Endpoints in the hazoom-dev namespace, observable from the OS.

title: Mixture of multi-turn
body: Long-context models extend attention to hundreds of thousands of tokens. Costs scale with context length; MLA and sliding-window attention are common mitigations.
